description: Peaceful contemplation. Realization of Brahman. No active service but awareness of transcendence.
Servitorship. Active reverence and desire to serve. Hanumān is the exemplar.
Friendship. Equality in love. The cowherd boys of Vṛndāvana.
Parental love. The devotee loves God as a child. Yaśodā and Nanda.
Conjugal love. The highest rasa. Complete self-giving. The gopīs of Vṛndāvana.
Humor. Laughter arising from incongruity in līlā.
Wonder. Astonishment at the Lord's inconceivable potencies.
Heroism. Valor in service. Arjuna on the battlefield.
Compassion. Grief in separation. Rādhā's viraha.
Fury. Righteous anger in protection of dharma.
Fear. Dread before the Lord's universal form.
Disgust. Revulsion toward māyā and material attachment.
